==Major events==
* [[Fraud]] easily defeats [[Hariru]] and [[Carola]].
* Fearing that Fraud has become too powerful, [[Ryouga]] and the others immediately use the Compass of Light to go find [[Arcades]].
* With the tracer put on [[Yappy]] previously, Fraud can find out where Ryouga will meet his old arch-enemy, Arcades.
